fields.label: Idempotency TTL (seconds)
fields.description: How long to remember duplicate webhook events. Default: 3600 (1 hour).

fields.label: Outbox Batch Size
fields.description: Max outbox entries re-enqueued per scheduler cycle. Default: 25.

fields.label: Max Inbound Media Size (MB)
fields.description: Maximum size for inbound media attachments. Default: 10 MB.

fields.label: Require HMAC Signature
fields.description: When checked, incoming webhooks without a valid HMAC signature are rejected.

fields.label: Webhook Rate Limit (req/min)
fields.description: Max inbound webhook requests per minute per IP. Default: 60.

fields.label: API Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: HTTP timeout for OpenWA REST API calls. Default: 30s.

fields.label: Session Start Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: HTTP timeout when starting an OpenWA session. Default: 60s.

fields.label: Circuit Breaker Threshold
fields.description: Number of consecutive send failures before circuit breaker trips. Default: 5.

fields.label: Circuit Breaker Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after circuit breaker trips. Default: 300.

fields.label: Max Outbox Retry Attempts
fields.description: Max delivery retries per outbox entry before marking as Failed. Default: 5.
